title: Card Surcharge on Homesite Reservation Extension Fees
content:
Where the reservation deposit of a Homesite Reservation was paid by card, an extension card surcharge applies to the hold extension fee. It is read from the payments received on the reservation ledger with the component reservation deposit only.

**Rule.** The extension card surcharge is **10** percent where card payments make up the whole reservation deposit received, **5** percent where card payments make up part but not all of it, and nothing where no part of it was paid by card.

## Surcharge table

| Card share of the reservation deposit received | Extension card surcharge |
|---|---|
| whole | 10 percent |
| part but not all | 5 percent |
| none | nothing |

## Ledger cases (hypothetical)

- Reservation deposit of 1500.00 paid in two card payments: whole, 10 percent.
- Reservation deposit of 2500.00 paid 1000.00 by card and 1500.00 by wire: part, 5 percent.
- Reservation deposit paid by ACH and the premium holding fee paid by card: none, because only reservation deposit payments are counted.
- Reservation deposit paid entirely by card, with card convenience fee entries beside it: whole, 10 percent; the convenience fee entries are a separate component and are not counted.
